description.p: differ is a focused desktop Git change explorer for commit history, contributors, diffs, AI commit generation, working tree status, and repository sync state.

Features include multi-provider AI commit messages (Ollama, Gemini, LM Studio), commit editing and amending, SMTP patch emails, GPG signing, GitHub history/issues/PRs/Actions views, and one-click external editor launchers.
Flatpak release: sandboxed build with host git/gpg/ssh integration via flatpak-spawn.
